{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]
print(f"Number of patients with multiple rows: {len(duplicate_patients)}")
print(f"Patients with duplicates: {list(duplicate_patients.index)}")"}
